    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceNeeded" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">parcel insurance is necessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>

rules.instruction: When the description names multiple activities that must all occur and another activity that occurs only in certain cases as part of the same stage: Model the required activities and the conditional activity so synchronization waits for all required work but only for conditional branches that were activated; use an inclusive split and join rather than a parallel join that waits for every possible branch.
rules.situation: the description states that one activity is required while another activity in the same stage occurs only if a condition holds

rules.instruction: When the description states distinct conditions for different decisions or qualifies an activity separately from a decision: Label each BPMN gateway with the condition it actually represents; do not transfer a condition from a separate decision or activity.
rules.situation: the description states distinct conditions for different decisions or qualifies an activity separately from a decision

rules.instruction: When the description says an internal role solicits offers from outside organizations and chooses among them: Model the stated solicitation and selection work in the internal process. Do not add separate participant pools or message flows for the outside organizations unless the description establishes them as process participants exchanging messages.
rules.situation: the description says an internal role solicits offers from outside organizations and chooses among them

rules.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities without specifying their order and states that a later outcome depends on all of them: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them before that outcome.
rules.situation: the description says that required activities can proceed independently and that a later activity depends on all of them being complete.

rules.instruction: When the description states that a condition determines whether an action or process path is needed: model the choice with an exclusive gateway and conditional branches for the possible outcomes.
rules.situation: the description makes an activity conditional on a stated readiness condition

rules.instruction: When the description assigns activities in one organizational process to multiple internal roles: Represent the organization’s process in one participant pool and use lanes for the stated internal roles; do not omit the process pool or model ordinary internal roles as separate pools.
rules.situation: the description assigns activities in one organizational process to multiple internal roles

rules.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules.situation: the description states that a particular activity is performed in one of the alternative cases
